description: Core infrastructure: i18n system, enhanced micro-interactions CSS, and skeleton loading improvements. This feature establishes the foundation that other features depend on: a lightweight custom i18n context/store for multilingual support, additional CSS animations for micro-interactions (scroll-triggered reveals, hover states, shimmer effects), and improved skeleton screen usage patterns.
steps: Create `frontend/src/stores/i18n.store.ts` - a Zustand store with persist middleware that holds: current locale ('ar'|'en'), translation dictionaries for both languages, a `t(key)` helper function, and `setLocale` action. Include a `dir` computed property ('rtl' for ar, 'ltr' for en). Store dictionary inline for core UI strings (navigation labels, common actions, page titles from AppShell PAGE_TITLES). Use the persist middleware with localStorage key 'madarek-locale'.

Create `frontend/src/lib/i18n.ts` - export a `useTranslation()` hook that returns `{ t, locale, setLocale, dir }` from the i18n store. Also export a `<LangToggle />` component (a small pill button that toggles ar/en).

Update `frontend/src/components/layout/AppShell.tsx` - read locale/dir from i18n store, set `document.documentElement.dir` and `document.documentElement.lang` in a useEffect when locale changes. Add the LangToggle to the Topbar area (import from i18n lib).

Create `frontend/src/styles/world-class.css` - new CSS file with: (a) Enhanced micro-interactions: scroll-reveal animations using `@keyframes reveal-up`, `reveal-scale`, `reveal-fade`; CSS classes `.reveal`, `.reveal-up`, `.reveal-scale` that animate on entry. (b) Shimmer/pulse animation for skeleton improvements. (c) Floating widget animations (for Oasis AI). (d) Gamification badge pulse/glow effects. (e) Dashboard card stagger animations. (f) Search dropdown slide-in animation. (g) LTR overrides: `[dir='ltr']` rules that flip margins/paddings/border directions for English mode.
Import `world-class.css` in `frontend/src/main.tsx` after the last existing CSS import.

Create `frontend/src/hooks/useRevealOnScroll.ts` - a custom hook that uses IntersectionObserver to add `.revealed` class to elements with `.reveal` class when they enter the viewport. Accept a ref to the scroll container (for use inside AppShell's `.content` div).
acceptance_criteria: i18n store initializes with 'ar' locale by default and persists choice to localStorage
Calling setLocale('en') updates document dir to 'ltr' and lang to 'en'
LangToggle component renders and toggles between ar/en
world-class.css defines at least 5 new keyframe animations for micro-interactions
world-class.css includes [dir='ltr'] overrides for sidebar border, text alignment
useRevealOnScroll hook uses IntersectionObserver API correctly
TypeScript compilation passes with no errors (npx tsc -b --noEmit)
verification: Run `npx tsc -b --noEmit` in frontend/ directory to confirm type-check passes
Run `npx vite build` in frontend/ directory to confirm build succeeds
findings: TypeScript tsc and Vite build tools are not functional in this sandbox environment. node_modules directories exist but are empty stubs. The global tsc (v6.0.3) shows 6027 errors on the baseline due to missing module type declarations. All errors from the new files follow the same pattern (cannot find module 'zustand'/'react') as existing store files. npx vite build fails with E403 because npm registry access is blocked. Code verified to follow identical patterns as existing stores/hooks and introduces no unique type errors.
